title: One finite coefficient projection of the normalized completed diagonal integral
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_finiteIntegralProjection
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)] (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (hf : f = pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) ∨
      f = pullback.snd (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (t : Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (a : SupportedSource l Y f t.Rc)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l (ProjectiveLine Y)).map
        (a.hom ≫ t.Rc.R.map δ ≫ t.trace) ≫
      ((diagonalCompletedRestriction l (ProjectiveLine Y)).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
        0).hom.app _ ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalMod l (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).map
        (t.coefficientsS.coefficientProjection.app (op n)) =
    ((diagonalCompletedRestriction l (ProjectiveLine Y)).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
        0).hom.app _ ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalMod l (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).map
        (t.coefficientsS.coefficientProjection.app (op n))

proof.text: Apply diagonalTrace_finitePretrace_components to the normalized supported diagonal source and its IsDiagonalLimit witness. It gives a base summand and a coefficient-one relative Chern summand before applying any trace, for either projection selected by hf.

Map the unit hY through the projective-line structure morphism to obtain invertibility of l on ProjectiveLine Y. Apply the proved general diagonalTrace_integral_of_components to the map a.hom followed by Rc.map δ and the preceding component equation. Associativity identifies its trace composite with the exact expression in the statement.
